skill_name: Explain how artificial intelligence can be used to shape the future of marketing
workflow: Artificial intelligence (AI) is already being used to shape the future of marketing by helping marketers better understand their customers and personalize their services in order to increase engagement levels with customers. AI-powered technologies can be used to gather and analyze large amounts of customer data, make smarter decisions and automate repetitive tasks in the marketing process.
